checks: Every reachable transition, not sampled traces.
Both models: no false-availability cycle and maximum consecutive false availability <= K-1.
Exact binary: no false withholding. Sound-positive-only: false withholding is allowed and must be reachable.
Every false-availability state has 1<=age<K; every edge between false-available states increments age by one.
kind: Finite model for conditional arguments; no probes or production policy change.

negative_controls.change: Allow all three outcomes for both truth values.
Keep old availability on insufficient_evidence while resetting age=0.
negative_controls.expected: Reachable false-availability cycle even though supported remains sound.

normal_result: available iff supported; all completed validations reset age=0; skipped transitions carry availability and increment age
scope: Nondeterministic validation outcomes, not measured failure frequencies.
Finite exploration supports a separate rank/transition argument for arbitrary positive integer K.
Initial available claim assumed true. Claim, history order and validator contract fixed.
No assertions about wall time, unfinished runs, real validator soundness, production resume or main empirical evaluation.
selection: baseline trigger OR previous unavailable OR age+1>=K
